#   ADDRESS,NAME,TYPE,COUNT,SIZE,SRC,BLOCK

# library metadata, so there should be no sdk rows -
# one appearing means an analyser guessed a name.

# excluded. A label we have not chosen is not knowledge.
#
# Enum constants are NOT here - they live with their enum
